messages:
jamie.ops: kicking off a wedge rollout for service/frontend v3.2.1 -> 10% traffic in eu-west/us-east/ap-south. holding for 20m safety window. deploy-bot will post updates. please ack :eyes:

deploy-bot: starting traffic shift: route=frontend, from=stable(3.2.0) to=3.2.1, target_pct=10, regions=[eu-west,us-east,ap-south] -- action_id=wdg-20260320-01

sasha.eng: acked. quick q — any schema changes in this build?

jamie.ops: no schema changes. only perf fixes and a KV cache tweak for long prompts. we ran a short smoke on staging.

lee.release: release notes uploaded to the release channel and tagged in the changelog. pinging support docs for the spike playbook.

maya.sre: seeing a small latency blip on eu-west (p95 + 170ms) in the first 2 minutes of rollout, small sample. not alarming yet but flagging.

jamie.ops: thanks @maya.sre. keep watching p95 & error-rate. if error-rate > 0.8% sustained for 3m we call stop.

arnold.qa: best-effort regression tests running against 3.2.1. will report functional failures here. current suite: auth, session, streaming, embeddings. no failures so far.

deploy-bot: metrics snapshot t+5m: eu-west p95 +150ms, us-east p95 +30ms, ap-south p95 +20ms. global 5xx rate 0.12% (baseline 0.08%).

maya.sre: now 5xx spiking to 0.95% in eu-west over last 2m, CPU on podpool-frontend-eu trending up, tail latencies climbing.

jamie.ops: stop the wedge. runbook says immediate traffic rollback to stable if region 5xx >0.8%. roll back eu-west first, hold others.

deploy-bot: executing rollback: route=frontend, region=eu-west, target_version=3.2.0, action=rollback, action_id=wdg-20260320-01-rollback-eu

lee.release: updating release notes pinned status: marking 3.2.1 as paused in eu-west. adding note about KV cache tuning follow-up.

arnold.qa: QA: running targeted tests on 3.2.0 in eu-west to confirm stability post-rollback.

maya.sre: eu-west rollback complete. 5xx back to baseline 0.09%. p95 returning to normal.

jamie.ops: good — hold all other regions at 0% until triage complete. assign an owner to dig into the KV cache interaction and CPU bump.

lee.release: making a postmortem note in the release doc and scheduling a follow-up triage at +30m.

jamie.ops: owner = sasha.eng to lead triage, maya.sre on observability, arnold.qa to reproduce in lab. we'll reconvene in 25m for stop/go. :thumbsup:

sasha.eng: on it. starting with GC traces + KV cache eviction logs, will paste relevant snippets here.

deploy-bot: action summary: wedge rollout paused/rolled-back in eu-west. current traffic: eu-west -> 3.2.0, us-east -> 3.2.0, ap-south -> 3.2.0 (held). logs and artifacts uploaded to https://artifacts.internal/redwood/wdg-20260320-01

jamie.ops: thanks team. no further traffic moves until triage says go.

maya.sre: acked. monitoring alert thresholds tightened for next 1h.

arnold.qa: noted, will add reproduction steps and failing traces to the ticket.

sasha.eng: initial finding: KV cache eviction burst during warmup under certain prompt shapes. reproducing locally, will propose a config tweak or revert in the next hour.

jamie.ops: excellent. we'll meet back at 2361723670 for decision. if fix is small we may retry wedge at 5% with tighter observability.
